entries.0d1886458422ab8e: Construction and civil engineering contractors in South America
entries.1b9a83e2a77b9268: A consolidated subsidiary in West Java Province, Republic of Indonesia, it manufactures and sells raw yarn, cloth, Ramikurosu and other products related to synthetic resin processed products.
entries.20cd71698412fd1f: A consolidated subsidiary in McAllen, Texas, United States, it manufactures and sells fruit and vegetable packaging material “Merutakku.”
entries.4f7bb520335051e3: The company is headquartered in Mizushima, Kurashiki, Okayama Prefecture, and manufactures and sells synthetic resin processed products and industrial machinery. The company and 16 subsidiaries form the group, and consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended October 2025 number 1,292. The company is listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.5ab1e441c5843d2e: Customers that adopt the company's products
entries.5cec72aac5d7a26c: A consolidated subsidiary headquartered in Kurashiki, Okayama Prefecture, it oversees domestic and overseas sales of concrete reinforcing fiber “Baruchippu.” It also sells overseas through overseas subsidiaries such as Baruchippu Asia.
entries.67c9099cc7f7c795: Customers for fruit and vegetable packaging
entries.7bde8c97959a1e98: This segment manufactures and sells films, raw yarn, cloth, Ramikurosu and secondary products made from these. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥26,293 million. Its main products include concrete reinforcing fiber “Baruchippu,” fruit and vegetable packaging material “Merutakku,” and blue sheets and heat-shielding sheets, and it also manufactures and sells through overseas subsidiaries in Indonesia, the United States, Paraguay and other countries.
entries.7fdaf56df6be3bb1: North American customers for fruit and vegetable packaging
entries.98b709b943a3dbb9: A manufacturer headquartered in Kurashiki, Okayama Prefecture, that manufactures and sells processed products such as synthetic resin yarn and sheets, and industrial machinery such as slitters.
entries.a2c4cac4320260d1: It is a segment that manufactures and sells various industrial machinery, including slitters, winders and extrusion-related equipment. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 were ¥5,642 million. It also handles slitters for metal foil, cleaning equipment for plastic recycling, and screen changers for advanced filtration, among others.
entries.a624db0ee6924c5f: A consolidated subsidiary in Shanghai, China, that designs, manufactures and sells various industrial machinery, including slitters, winders and extrusion-related equipment.
entries.b327e1d42cbadaf5: A consolidated subsidiary in Thailand that manufactures and sells the company's products and provides installation, operation guidance and after-sales service for them.
entries.b8e46fad0028e6f2: A consolidated subsidiary headquartered in Kasumigaura, Ibaraki Prefecture, it manufactures and sells films, raw yarn and Ramikurosu related to synthetic resin processed products. Large-volume demand for films for drinking water continues.
entries.e59d7fe4cdf82826: A consolidated subsidiary in Ciudad del Este, Republic of Paraguay, that manufactures and sells the concrete reinforcing fiber “Baruchippu” and is responsible for stable supply to the South American market.
